questionPassage.colQuestionContentParagraphHint: This is the piece of information the student must find — enter one statement per question. Put the shared instruction (e.g. "Which paragraph contains each of the following pieces of information?") once, at the top of the passage content instead.
questionPassage.colQuestionContentBlankPlaceholder: e.g. You need to pay ___ for the visa.
questionPassage.colQuestionContentBlankHint: Type ___ (3+ underscores) where the blank should appear inline. When 2 or more Fill-in-Blank questions follow each other, they render together as one compact notes block (e.g. for Note/Form/Table Completion) instead of separate cards. You can add a line break after the blank to include extra plain text on its own line (e.g. a trailing note with no blank of its own).
